standard_name: DEMO STANDARD: IEC 60364 / IEEE 141 Low Voltage Industrial Electrical Rules
description: Demonstration rules for three-phase and single-phase industrial electrical power installations.

rules.description: Three-phase industrial motor feeders must operate at standard rated 415 V supply.
System AC line frequency must be standard 50 Hz or 60 Hz.
Busbar continuous feeder current must not exceed switchgear frame rating of 630 A.
